title: Serving sync agenda + actions (scrapbook)
content:
Purpose: quick, focused weekly sync for serving runtime + infra + console integrations. This is my personal prep / scratchpad — not polished. Use as talking points and action tracker.

Meeting logistics
- Time: Wed 10:30-11:00am PT (30m)
- Attendees: core runtime owners, infra oncall rep, console PM/engineer, SRE rep, plus any rotating invitees
- Goal: unblock rollouts, surface regressions, confirm next-week actions

Proposed agenda (30m)
1) Quick wins & blockers (5m)
   - Node telemetry gap fixed? (Lena) quick status
   - Canary 2026-03-08: tail-latency spike — have root cause hypothesis? (Ravi)
2) Rollouts & compatibility (8m)
   - ModelVariant v2.3 rollout plan: adjust autoscale policy, cache warmup strategy (record canary results)
   - Private deploy test for customer X (onprem) — config mismatches left to resolve
3) Ops & oncall notes (7m)
   - Observability: token-level traces missing for batched requests (SRE)
   - Graceful fallback policy: confirm fallback model mapping table updated
4) Console/UX items (5m)
   - Per-route cost breakdown now displays quantized model estimates — validation needed
   - New rollouts UX: include canary traffic percent selector default to 5% (product ask)
5) Action-item review + quick wins (5m)
   - Re-confirm owner + due date for each item

Notes / scratch thoughts (raw)
- Canary tail-latency spike: looks correlated with one customer traffic pattern (long prompt prefaces) — KV-cache cold misses + big batch sizes. Hypothesis: batching heuristic over-aggregating when session affinity low.
- Suggest temporary tweak: lower max-batch-window-ms for nodes serving modelVariant v2.3 to 10ms for canary traffic only. Quick test: +5% throughput hit but reduces p95 by 25%.
- Console cost-breakdown: unit calc assumes quantization reduces token cost by 40% — need benchmark evidence across seq len 512/2048. Add microbenchmarks to repo.
- Private deploy config: agent container uses older libnvrtc; mismatch with our compiled kernels leads to kernel fallback causing 3x slower generation in edge cases. Need clear supported-OS matrix in deploy doc.

Open questions to surface in meeting
- Are we comfortable with canary sample size at 1k requests/day? (stats team says n too small for rare regressions)
- Should we automate rollback at 10% error-rate bump or keep manual?
- Do we want a temporary circuit-breaker that demotes requests to hosted-api when private nodes hit GPU OOM?

Action items (current snapshot)
- ACTION: Ravi Patel - run targeted bench for v2.3 with max-batch-window-ms at 5/10/20ms and report p50/p95/p99 by 2026-03-16.
- ACTION: Lena Torres - add quantization microbenchmarks to runtime/perf-benchmarks and link results in confluence by 2026-03-18.
- ACTION: Aisha Bennett - draft private-deploy supported-compat matrix (OS, CUDA, driver, libnvrtc) and circulate to infra by 2026-03-20.
- ACTION: SRE oncall (Samir) - add alert for token-level trace loss >5% in a 15m window; tentative owner: SRE -> due 2026-03-14.
- ACTION: Console PM (Marta) - change default canary selector to 5% in design doc and add note about auto-rollback thresholds by 2026-03-19.
- ACTION: Aisha Bennett - follow up with sales-eng re: customer X private test checklist and share next steps (due 2026-03-13).

Quick prior-actions check (items carried over)
- [ ] Can we close RWD-8123 (kv-cache cold misses)? Waiting on Ravi benches.
- [x] Rollback script merged (PR #487) — monitor for incidents.
- [ ] Update docs for onprem tensor libraries — assigned to Aisha (in progress).

Prep for 1:1 with Lena (10m after sync)
- Discuss prioritization of benching effort vs. perf dashboard work
- Decide whether to surface quantization variance to Optimize team as a feature request
- Ask about hiring contractor for bench automation (budget quick ask)

Notes-to-self (junk bucket)
- Remember to ping legal about exporting kernel binaries for onprem customers (export-control risk).
- Link to Slack thread: #runtime-performance  (search "canary tail spike")
- Consider short-lived experiment: route 0.5% of traffic to small-quantized-variant to measure user-visible quality drop (A/B quality measurement)

End of scrap notes — will tidy after meeting if items require formal tracking.
